title: Toronto Yachts
specs: Only Transport Canada-licensed yacht charter company in downtown Toronto for power yachts
Fleet ranges from 40 to 86 feet, with capacity from 10 to 100 passengers
Awarded best charter company of the year in Canada 2023 with 5-star rating
Liquor license for boats under 100 passengers allowing alcohol consumption while underway
Multiple prime downtown Toronto docking locations
No minimum passenger requirement but minimum charge based on passenger count applies
Crewed charters require no guest license; bareboat charters require operator license
Transport Canada approved captains with required certifications operate all crewed charters
Yachts accommodate from 10 to 100 passengers; larger groups referred to licensed affiliates
includes: Experienced Captain with Master Mariner (Limited) and Chief Engineer credentials
First Mate or Smart Serve Server assisting with operations and hospitality
Fuel for the duration of the trip
Onboard amenities including full kitchen, air conditioning, bathrooms, showers, sun deck, and Bluetooth sound system
Professional crew including captain, chief engineer, and service staff
blurb: Guests charter luxury yachts ranging from 40 to 86 feet, accommodating 10 to 100 passengers. Charters include crewed service with certified captains and hospitality staff, onboard amenities like kitchens, air conditioning, showers, and Bluetooth sound systems. Various packages are available for sightseeing, dining, parties, weddings, corporate events, and custom experiences.
